phase: BACKLOG.md bug fix -- Studio-vs-Builder rendering divergence for Custom (Draw Your Own) Shapes. Two Fidelity gaps in the compile-then-render pipeline: (A) tools/world-builder-v2/js/services/builder.js's convergeSceneLayer shape branch silently dropped customStrokes (the newer multi-stroke Line/Circle Tool silhouette) and fillEnabled (the Transparent Fill toggle), both authored correctly in Builder but stripped at compile time before reaching Studio; (B) renderer/slideRenderer.js's _layerDrawShape kind=='custom' branch only checked customPath (the older single-freehand silhouette) and fell straight through to an inscribed-ellipse placeholder for any Custom Shape carrying customStrokes but no customPath (every recent Multi-Stroke authoring), so any Paint Inside strokes on it would have clipped to that ellipse rather than the authored silhouette.
milestone: Fix A (builder.js shape compile branch): additive customStrokes: layer.customStrokes || null and fillEnabled: layer.fillEnabled !== false, matching how every other shape-adjacent field (shapeFillColor/shapeFillOpacity/shapeStrokeColor/shapeStrokeOpacity/shapeStrokeWidth/shapeRotation/customPath) already rides the same compile step. Fix B (slideRenderer.js _layerDrawShape custom branch): checks d.customStrokes FIRST, dispatches to the existing _buildCustomStrokePath helper (already proven correct for the Story-owned Shape sticker path via _drawSceneShape/_drawCustomStrokeShape, established discipline for this class of multi-stroke silhouette), then falls through to d.customPath, then to the inscribed-ellipse placeholder. Absent customStrokes stays null; absent fillEnabled resolves to true via _paintShapePathTail's own established style.fillEnabled!==false gate, so every pre-fix compiled Theme still renders byte-identically.
slice: Verified 18/18 via bug_shape_render_divergence_verify.js: P1 compile-side (12/12) hand-builds a real Scene Layer with customStrokes via ProjectStore.create('blank')+ProjectModel.addSceneLayer, runs real ProjectCompiler.runBuild(), confirms decoration.customStrokes array + decoration.fillEnabled land correctly; P2 render-side (6/6) mocks ThemeEngine with a synthetic Artwork Theme carrying 3 distinct compiled Layer Pack entries (multi-stroke green, legacy customPath magenta, no-strokes ellipse-fallback blue), calls real SlideRenderer.render(), pixel-samples all three render correctly. Three real test-methodology bugs found and fixed during verification (ProjectStore.create returns project directly not {project} wrapper; synthetic theme was missing frame.color/panel/storyText/footerText/watermark; layerEngine.js dispatches by layer.type so 'decoration' had to be added). Full regression: both goldenBuild.js suites PASS unchanged; museum_realfile_pixelhash.js SHA-256 e7b2a905613dbef3d2f9064211103d84762d7039d3bee404df90f4d90899b390 byte-identical; shapes_paint_inside_verify.js 30/30 and wb_paint_inside_verify.js 36/36 both pass unchanged. Disclosed, not yet investigated: 'places placeholder art' + 'background transparency' halves of the report deferred pending concrete reproduction.
